description: California Public Safety Power Shutoff (PSPS) Events is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. Data provided to the The State of California and the California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) by the utilities via their Public Safety Power Shutoff (PSPS) reports including post-season data reports, data request responses, and post-event reports. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are historic outage data , distribution grid outages, electricity outages, electric power failures. The portal shows 2025-06-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is No license, or terms of use, asserted by data producer for this dataset was found.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
